# The flags on #[foreign] state what a call costs, which is the half of a
# foreign declaration SNGL cannot read off the body: the body describes the
# foreign function rather than implementing it.

# pure lets the compiler evaluate the call at build time — the result is in the
# markup and the function is gone.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=pure pure.sngl
grep '<span>5</span>' pure/index.html
! grep 'function add' pure/index.html

# Without it the call is left alone: nothing infers purity from a body the call
# never reaches, so a stub body cannot fold its own answer into the program.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=stub stub.sngl
grep 'function add' stub/index.html
! grep '<span>0</span>' stub/index.html

# async is the same fact the TypeScript importer reads off Promise<T>, so it
# drives the same lowering: the computed that calls it is hoisted behind a
# settled-state field and an async kicker awaits the call. Nothing was imported
# to say so — the mark is the only source of it.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=async async.sngl
grep 'async function \$compute___hoist_0' async/index.html
grep 'await fetchHello' async/index.html

# A misspelled flag is a spelling error the compiler can see, so it names the
# alternatives rather than ignoring the flag.
! sngl check typo.sngl
stderr 'unknown value "puer"'
stderr 'pure, async'

# The flags describe a call, so a declaration that has none refuses them.
! sngl check onstruct.sngl
stderr 'which describes a call'

-- pure.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:macro"

#[foreign("js:./api", "add", pure)]
func add(a int, b int) => a + b

component main {
    text(value=string(add(2, 3)))
}

-- stub.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:macro"

#[foreign("js:./api", "add")]
func add(a int, b int) => 0

component main {
    text(value=string(add(2, 3)))
}

-- async.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:macro"

#[foreign("js:./api", "fetchHello", async)]
func fetchHello(name string) => "hi " + name

func greeting() => fetchHello("world")

component main {
    text(value=greeting())
}

-- typo.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:macro"

#[foreign("js:./api", "add", puer)]
func add(a int, b int) => a + b

component main {
    text(value=string(add(2, 3)))
}

-- onstruct.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:macro"

#[foreign("js:./api", "Entry", pure)]
struct Entry {
    title string
}

component main {
    text(value=Entry{title = "x"}.title)
}
